build_Basenet_MLP: build a BaseNet MLP with configurable depth, hidden channels, skip connections, and activation functions
build_NeRFNet_network: build a NeRFNet with position and direction positional encoding for neural radiance fields
run_Basenet_forward: run the BaseNet forward pass on input tensor with optional sigma_only flag
run_NeRFNet_forward: run the NeRFNet forward pass splitting input into position and direction embeddings
review_net_dict_registry: review the net_dict registry mapping base and nerf keys to their network classes
